ops.value: Raised Nose
Lifting the nose feeds clean air under the car to the flat bottom and the diffuser.
Diffuser Profile
A steeper diffuser exit that pulls more air from under the flat bottom.
Anhedral Front Wing
A front wing slung under the raised nose. More front grip, a little more drag.
Multi-Element Rear Wing
A third rear-wing element for the slow circuits. Downforce at the cost of straight-line speed.
Sidepods and Cooling Exits
Tighter sidepods and smaller radiator exits cut drag; the engine runs hotter for it.
Flat-Bottom Aero Package
A new undertray, diffuser and rear wing developed together in the wind tunnel.
Carbon-Fibre Tub
A stiffer, lighter monocoque lay-up from the autoclave.
Weight-Saving Programme
Titanium fasteners, lighter ancillaries and ballast moved low, towards the 500 kg limit.
Pushrod Suspension Geometry
Revised pushrod and rocker geometry that keeps the tyres flatter on the road.
B-Spec Car
The mid-season evolution: a new chassis built on everything learnt so far. The team races the B-spec car once it is fitted.
Carbon Brake Package
Carbon discs and pads with new cooling ducts.
Active Suspension
Computer-controlled hydraulic suspension that holds the ride height. A big, late project.
Camshaft Profiles
New cam profiles for more power at the top of the rev range.
High-Rev Valve Train
A lighter valve train that lets the engine rev higher.
Lean Fuel Mapping
With refuelling banned, every litre counts: a leaner mixture for the opening laps.
Low-Consumption Package
Combustion chamber and injection work that lets the car start with less fuel.
Evolution-Spec Engine
The works engine's next specification, only for the factory team.
Qualifying Engine Mode
A higher rev limit and a richer mixture, used only in qualifying.
Qualifying Engine
A short-life engine built for one qualifying session. Qualifying only.
Gearbox Internals
Stronger gears and selector forks for the manual gearbox.
Engine Rebuild Standards
Tighter tolerances at every rebuild between races.
Wiring and Electrics
A new loom and sealed connectors. Fewer electrical retirements.
Radiator and Oil Cooling
Bigger oil coolers and a revised radiator core for the hot races.
Gearbox Casing and Oil System
A stiffer casing and a new oil system for the gearbox.
Semi-Automatic Gearbox
A paddle-shift gearbox project. Faster, safer shifts once it is reliable.
Paddle-Shift Reliability
Ferrari raced the first paddle-shift gearbox; this project makes it last.
